blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

Conflicts flagged up front: (1) Ocean Park Place's built year conflicts — the building directory states 1979 while MLS listings for its units state 1978 — so the year is carried as 1978–1979 not confirmed in. (2) Rockford by Cressey's unit count conflicts — the developer's own feature sheet states 63 condominium residences while presale sources state 60 condominiums — carried as a conflict, not settled, in; Rockford is a presale (estimated completion 2027 on the presale records read), not completed resale stock, and is documented but not counted.
Ocean Park Place — 12890 17 Avenue, Ocean Park

The building directory records the name Ocean Park Place at this address, built 1979, 54 units, with club house, elevator and storage; MLS listings for units at the address record sub-type Apartment/Condo, strata plan NWS1191, complex name "Ocean Park", and built 1978 — the year therefore conflicts (directory 1979 vs listings 1978) and is carried as 1978–1979 not confirmed. Directory restrictions: age restrictions; pets not allowed; rentals not allowed — that recorded line is void for long-term rentals under the Nov 24, 2022 rule in. The directory does not state the age in its restriction line; two unit listings describe the building in their text as a "55 PLUS BUILDING" and a "well-managed 55+ community" — listing text only, so the exact age bylaw is not confirmed until the registered bylaws are read, and no other age is asserted here.

items.t: "Crescent Beach Ocean Park" in full (MLS® "Crescent Bch Ocean Pk.") is one board sub-area joining two seaside communities — Crescent Beach, a low village at the mouth of the Nicomekl River below the Crescent Heights bluff, and Ocean Park, on the east side of Boundary Bay — and one of nine sub-areas of the Fraser Valley board community "S Surrey White Rock". The street-level board boundary is not verified — no public street-level boundary was opened, and no municipal boundary was substituted.
White Rock's own bylaws (Zoning Bylaw 2024 No. 2506 / OCP Bylaw 2017 No. 2220) belong to White Rock only and are never applied to a Surrey-address building here.
Community context only (whole S Surrey White Rock community, not this sub-area's prices): Detached median $1,628,000; Condos & Townhomes median $700,000 / $524 per sq ft / 99% sale-to-list / 33 DOM.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Crescent Beach / Ocean Park

items.t: OCP / Zoning — Surrey: Surrey Official Community Plan Bylaw 21900 (adopted Jun 15, 2026) is current — never cite 18020 as current. Surrey Zoning Bylaw 12000 governs. The Crescent Beach Local Area Plan guides Crescent Beach parcels within that frame.

SSMUH — Surrey (City position as stated): maximum 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m², 4 units on lots larger than 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop; the City adopted the SSMUH zoning changes on July 8, 2024.

ALR block (where ALR ground exists — parcel status here not confirmed): subdivision within the ALR requires Agricultural Land Commission approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)). ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an error.

Strata block (bare-land strata parcels, if a parcel is one): Form B within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page; depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws void since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss.123.1/123.2 + May 1, 2023 exemptions). A "45+" listing line is not a valid BC age bylaw. A fee-simple lot carries none of this.

FTHB PTT exemption: first $500,000 exempt, full at value ≤$835,000 (max saving $8,000), partial to $860,000; Newly Built Home Exemption is a new-HOME exemption (full to $1,100,000, eliminated at $1,150,000).

Foreclosure / court sales (where met): a settled court process exists (BC Supreme Court Civil Rules 21-7 / 13-5, Practice Direction PD-66, Form 60); whether Form B and the PTT/GST treatment on a court-ordered sale of a lot here differ is not confirmed. Surrey has no Supreme Court registry (registry mapping not verified).
